question: If the median of a data is 80.32 less than its mode, then the median of the data exceeds its mean by _____. (Use empirical formula)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **Empirical relationship** states: (**Mode** − **Median**) = 2 × (**Median** − **Mean**).

Given: **Mode** − **Median** = 80.32.

Let (**Median** − **Mean**) = x.

80.32 = 2 × x

x = 80.32 ÷ 2 = 40.16.

**∴ The correct answer is 40.16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference between **Mode** and **Median** = 80.32

**Formula Used:**

**Empirical Formula**: **Mode** = 3 × **Median** − 2 × **Mean**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3eeef0aecdd8c5dd80a3fb8ce9ef9c1a2c1301d9624bf9992dbb35a9c4f3cbb4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Mode** = 3 × **Median** − 2 × **Mean**

Subtract **Median** from both sides:

⇒ **Mode** − **Median** = (3 × **Median** − 2 × **Mean**) − **Median**

⇒ **Mode** − **Median** = 2 × **Median** − 2 × **Mean**

⇒ **Mode** − **Median** = 2 × (**Median** − **Mean**)

Substitute the given value (80.32):

⇒ 80.32 = 2 × (**Median** − **Mean**)

⇒ **Median** − **Mean** = 80.32 ÷ 2

⇒ **Median** − **Mean** = 40.16

**∴ The correct answer is 40.16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship is **Mode** = 3 **Median** − 2 **Mean**.

Symmetrical Distribution

In a perfectly **symmetrical distribution**, the **Mean**, **Median**, and **Mode** are all equal (Mean = Median = Mode).

Skewness

If **Mean** > **Median** > **Mode**, the distribution is **positively skewed**. If **Mode** > **Median** > **Mean**, it is **negatively skewed**.</p
